pages.title: Frame Dragging
pages.text: $(thing)Frame Dragging$()$(br2)A spinning mass drags spacetime round with it: a gyroscope in orbit round the Earth turns, by forty milliarcseconds a year, for no other reason. Unlocks the Lense-Thirring Vortex Core.

$(thing)Insight$(): 170$(br2)$(thing)Builds on$(): Geodesics, The Penrose Process.$(br2)$(thing)Samples$(): 2 Precision Gyroscope, 2 Pulsar Timing Record.$(br2)$(thing)Derivation$(): A body with angular momentum L drags the spacetime round it. Write the rate Ω at which a gyroscope's axis is turned at distance r, with G and c.
